cards.lore: Basement membrane is Type IV collagen + laminin. Split it like a cheap rug, and you get Alport syndrome.
cards.power: Barrier Seal. Blocks all non-lymphocyte tokens from crossing the board.

cards.lore: Gluten wrecks Barney's hair (Villous atrophy = Coeliac disease). No hair, no absorption.
cards.power: Hyper-Absorb. Tap to digest and draw 3 nutrient cards.

cards.lore: Kartagener's syndrome = defective dynein arms. Immotile cilia mean chronic sinusitis and 50% chance of situs inversus.
cards.power: Mucociliary Escalator. Move 1 pathogen token to the Pharynx discard pile every turn.

cards.lore: Pemphigus vulgaris attacks the spines (desmoglein-3) in the stratum spinosum, causing suprabasal blisters.
cards.power: Keratin Armor. Sacrifice top layer to negate mechanical or chemical damage.

cards.lore: Umbrella cells use uroplakin to stop urea back-diffusion. Visible haematuria? Look out for urothelial carcinoma.
cards.power: Shape-Shift. Change form to nullify chemical burns from urine tokens.

cards.lore: Parotid is purely serous (dark). Sublingual is predominantly mucous (pale). Sjögren's kills the acini.
cards.power: Exocrine Eruption. Deal heavy enzymatic damage to food tokens.

cards.lore: Goblet cells in the oesophagus? That's Barrett's intestinal metaplasia. Risk of adenocarcinoma goes up.
cards.power: Mucin Blast. Create a 2-layer protective gel field.

cards.lore: Premmies lack Pete's surfactant, causing Respiratory Distress Syndrome. Antenatal steroids speed up Pete's maturation.
cards.power: Surfactant Synthesis. Reduce alveolar surface tension to 0. Prevent collapse.

cards.lore: Asbestos fibres pierce her, causing 20-50 year latency Mesothelioma.
cards.power: Frictionless Glide. Nullify organ Friction.

cards.lore: Liver sinusoids lack a basement membrane and have large fenestrae for free exchange.
cards.power: Gatekeeper. Control leukocyte rolling and vascular tone (NO).

cards.lore: Glycine is every 3rd position. No Vitamin C = poor prolyl hydroxylation = Scurvy (unstable collagen, bleeding).
cards.power: Tensile Strength. Grant indestructible structural scaffolding.

cards.lore: Alpha-1-antitrypsin deficiency allows neutrophil elastase to eat Fibro's elastin, causing emphysema.
cards.power: Matrix Remodel. Transform into Myofibroblast to contract wounds.

cards.lore: Heart failure causes pulmonary alveolar macrophages to eat leaked RBCs to become haemosiderin-laden heart failure cells.
cards.power: Tissue Adaptation. Gain specific abilities based on organ zone.

cards.lore: Leukotrienes cause more sustained asthma and bronchospasm than histamine.
cards.power: Degranulation. Instantly inflict massive vasodilation and bronchospasm.

cards.lore: Brown fat uses UCP1 to uncouple electron transport, making heat instead of ATP.
cards.power: Thermogenesis / Satiety. Generate heat or suppress appetite.

cards.lore: Chondrocytes have NO blood vessels; they heal terribly. Loss of Carla in joints = Osteoarthritis eburnation.
cards.power: Compressive Resistance. Absorb massive mechanical loads.

cards.lore: Paget's disease shows chaotic mosaic cement lines and giant abnormal osteoclasts.
cards.power: Remodel. Couple osteoclast destruction with osteoblast creation.

cards.lore: Marfan syndrome = FBN1 (fibrillin) mutation. Poor scaffold leads to aortic root dissection and lens subluxation.
cards.power: Recoil. Return stretched tissue to resting state instantly.

cards.lore: No ATP after death = myosin can't detach from actin = Rigor mortis.
cards.power: Cross-Bridge Cycle. Consume 1 ATP to deal massive mechanical force.

cards.lore: Connexin-43 gap junctions allow the heart to beat as one. Ischaemia breaks them, causing arrhythmias.
cards.power: Functional Syncytium. Share electrical action potentials instantly.

cards.lore: Hirschsprung disease = absent ganglion cells in distal colon, meaning Sophia can't relax. Result: Megacolon.
cards.power: Sustained Tone. Maintain contraction using non-shivery energy.

cards.lore: Tetanus and Rabies use retrograde transport (dynein) to hijack the axon and ride back to the CNS.
cards.power: Action Potential. Transmit signals with absolute spatial precision.

cards.lore: Multiple Sclerosis is a T/B-cell attack on CNS myelin, slowing conduction and leaving glial scars.
cards.power: Saltatory Conduction. Increase nerve conduction velocity by 10x.

cards.lore: Hepatic encephalopathy causes Astro to absorb glutamine, raising intracranial pressure.
cards.power: Tripartite Support. Maintain the BBB and clear neurotransmitters.

cards.lore: Botulinum toxin cleaves SNARE proteins. No spine = no ACh release = flaccid paralysis.
cards.power: Neurotransmission. Convert electrical signal to chemical payload.

cards.lore: Local anesthetics block the myelinated Aδ (sharp pain) before the unmyelinated C fibers (dull pain).
cards.power: The Blood-Nerve Barrier. Perineurium seals the microenvironment.

cards.lore: Zone 1 (periportal) is the lowest O2 and highest CYP450. Paracetamol overdose and ischaemia kill Zone 3 first.
cards.power: First-Pass Metabolism. Filter and detoxify all portal blood.

cards.lore: Podocyte foot process effacement (visible only on EM) destroys the barrier, causing massive proteinuria (Minimal Change Disease).
cards.power: Ultra-Filtration. Separate plasma from blood cells and large proteins.

cards.lore: Asplenic patients cannot remove Howell-Jolly bodies from RBCs and are vulnerable to encapsulated bacteria.
cards.power: Senescent Clearance. Destroy aged/rigid RBCs and mount T-independent responses.

cards.lore: Follicular lymphoma overexpresses BCL2, making B-cells immortal even when they fail the arena test.
cards.power: Affinity Maturation. Evolve high-affinity antibodies over months.

cards.lore: DiGeorge syndrome causes autoimmunity/ectodermal dysplasia (APS-1). Autoreactive T-cells graduate that shouldn't.
cards.power: Central Tolerance. Prevent autoimmune disease via negative selection.

cards.lore: Follicular lymphoma infiltrates the marrow in a paratrabecular pattern, clinging to the bone edges.
cards.power: Haematopoiesis. Spawn infinite blood cell tokens.

cards.lore: Type 1 Diabetes = targeted T-cell strike on the central Beta islets; the Alpha wolves get a bad rep but lose regulation.
cards.power: Endocrine Counter-Regulation. Balance blood glucose via portal paracrine signalling.

cards.lore: Fibroblastic foci and honeycombing (destroyed bubbles) are the hallmark of Usual Interstitial Pneumonia (UIP).
cards.power: Gas Exchange. Swap O2 and CO2 across the thinnest barrier in biology.

cards.lore: Alport syndrome = failed switch to α3α4α5. The net splinters into a basket-weave, causing nephritis and deafness.
cards.power: Charge & Size Barrier. Repel anionic albumin.

cards.lore: Destruction of gastric parietal cells (fried-egg appearance) halts Intrinsic Factor, leading to Pernicious Anaemia.
cards.power: Peristaltic Digestion. Move and absorb nutrients sequentially.

cards.lore: Breach the Sertoli tight junctions, and the immune system will attack the sperm (autoimmune orchitis).
cards.power: Immunoprivilege. Shield meiotic antigens from autoimmune attack.

cards.lore: PCOS: Follicles arrest in development due to excess androgens and no FSH surge, causing polycystic morphology.
cards.power: Follicular Recruitment. Burn primordial follicles to generate one Graafian champion.

cards.lore: Bullous pemphigoid: Antibodies against BP180. The epidermis cleanly detaches from the dermis (subepidermal blister).
cards.power: Stratified Defence. Absorb UV radiation and mechanical shear.

cards.lore: Schistocytes = Microangiopathic Haemolytic Anaemia (TTP/HUS/DIC). A medical emergency.
cards.power: Diagnostic Snapshot. Reveal the entire haematological state in one look.

cards.lore: AL amyloid = light chains (myeloma). AA amyloid = acute phase 5A (chronic inflammation like RA/IBD).
cards.power: Fibrillary Accumulation. Slowly chokes organs with indestructible protein.

cards.lore: TB has caseeous (cheesy) necrosis. Sarcoidosis has naked non-caseating granulomas and causes hypercalcaemia via 1α-hydroxylase.
cards.power: Containment. Wall off indigestible threats.

cards.lore: Brain infarcts liquefy due to high lipolytic content. Heart infarcts coagulate, leaving ghost cells.
cards.power: Cell Death Autopsy. Reveal the exact mechanism of tissue destruction.

cards.lore: H&E can't see everything. Want to see if that is fibrosis? Congo Red (Sirius Red) will paint the fibrous collagen bright blue.
cards.power: Chemical Revelation. Reveal the hidden tissue components.

cards.lore: Carcinoma = Cytokeratin. Melanoma = S100. Lymphoma = CD20. CD45+.
cards.power: Lineage Identification. Force tumors to reveal their cell of origin.

cards.lore: Fabry disease shows lamellated zebra bodies. Membranous nephropathy shows subepithelial spike and dome deposits.
cards.power: Ultrastructural Vision. Diagnose diseases hidden below the light microscope barrier.

cards.lore: Used for sentinel lymph node or surgical margin checks. Leaves ice crystal artifacts, but speed saves lives.
cards.power: Intraoperative Guidance. After the course of surgery while the patient is asleep.

cards.lore: Microsatellite instability (MSI-H) in colorectal cancer predicts a massive response to pembrolizumab immunotherapy.
cards.power: Genetic Profiling. Match the tumour's driver mutation to the targeted therapy.

cards.lore: BAX/BAK cause death (cytochrome c release). BCL-2 prevents it. Venetoclax blocks BCL-2, forcing cancer to die.
cards.power: Programmed Death. Eliminate cells cleanly via intrinsic/extrinsic pathways.

cards.lore: Breast uses Nottingham (tubules/pleomorphism/mitoses). Prostate uses Gleason (gland architecture).
cards.power: Prognostic Grading. Predict aggressive behavior based on loss of normal structure.

cards.lore: Desmoplastic stroma (hard collagen) forms around invasive breast cancer. Lymphovascular invasion drastically upgrades prognosis.
cards.power: Invasion. Breach the capsule to unlock distant colonisation.

cards.lore: Follicular adenoma and carcinoma look identical on FNA cytology; you MUST excise the capsule to check for invasion.
cards.power: Hormone Storage. Store months of iodine outside the cell.

cards.lore: Invasive carcinoma LACKS the myoepithelial layer (p63/SMA negative). Lobular carcinoma files in single lines because it lost E-cadherin.
cards.power: Myoepithelial Check. Determine benign vs. invasive status.

cards.lore: Gleason 3+4=7 is Grade Group 2 (good). Gleason 4+3=7 is Grade Group 3 (worse). Cribriform (sieve-like) pattern is an automatic Grade 4.
cards.power: Architectural Scoring. Dictate treatment intensity via primary + secondary patterns.

cards.lore: Case 1: Lobular Breast Ca. Case 2: Bladder Ca metastatic to node. Case 3: Lupus Nephritis (Full House IF). Integrate or perish!
cards.power: Board Exam. Force the player to integrate all previous knowledge.

cards.lore: Red is for Collagen (Masson) or Amyloid (Congo). Brown is for IHC. Pink is H&E. Welcome to the Klub, you beautiful degenerate!
cards.power: Cheat Sheet. When in doubt, apply stain.
